request.text:
The bridge ballad's a sad one now. They always are, when you write them honestly.
<long pause>
A truce at the ford! I'll need a whole new verse. Possibly three.
<long pause>
Look who crossed the desert. The heroes of the ford, as I live and sing. I was beginning to think I'd have to give you a sad ending.
